item.autarkia.debug_wand.no_identity: That person has no identity yet
item.autarkia.debug_wand.no_selection: No person selected — right-click one first
Bonus added to whatever the Person is already doing, so small swings in pressure don't leave them dithering between two urges.
autarkia.config.option.brain.preempt.des: How much raw pressure a new urge needs before it may cut into a task already under way.
autarkia.config.option.instincts.flee_ra: Distance in blocks at which a threat starts to register at all.
Distance in blocks over which fear ramps from nothing to full panic.
autarkia.config.option.instincts.descend: Urge to climb down off a leftover pillar. Keep it below the interrupt threshold so a legitimate mid-climb chop is never cut short.
autarkia.config.option.instincts.wander_: The do-something floor: every real drive must beat this. At 0 an unbothered Person simply stands still.
How far, in blocks, an idle saunter may pick its next stop.
autarkia.config.option.instincts.flee_ra: Multiplies the notice range for a threat holding a bow, crossbow or trident — arrows out-reach claws, so fear starts farther out.
autarkia.config.option.instincts.flee_ap: Extra fear when a threat is measurably closing in — the observable stand-in for "it is hunting me".
autarkia.config.option.perception.sense_: Horizontal sensing radius in blocks. Cost grows with its square — a walking Person sweeps about 2R columns per block moved.
autarkia.config.option.perception.reads_: How many blocks one Person may read each tick. The main performance dial.
autarkia.config.option.perception.queue_: How many spotted-but-unexamined columns may back up before new sightings are dropped.
autarkia.config.option.perception.region: Block budget for scanning one structure; hitting it leaves the region marked as only partly known.
How far a scan may spread from where it began — what splits one fused mega-forest into separate groves.
autarkia.config.option.perception.knowle: How many places of each kind a Person remembers before the stalest is forgotten. Must exceed the trees they work among, or edge trees are forgotten and rediscovered forever.
autarkia.config.option.peers.radius.desc: How far away, in blocks, another being can be perceived at all.
autarkia.config.option.peers.sneak_range: Shrinks the range at which a sneaking being is noticed. Sneaking shortens how far away you are spotted; it never makes you invisible.
autarkia.config.option.peers.cone_degree: Horizontal field of view in degrees. Beings outside it go unseen until they make noise; 360 sees in every direction.
autarkia.config.option.peers.vertical_de: Half-angle in degrees above and below where the Person is looking — human sight is wide but flat. 90 removes the up/down limit.
autarkia.config.option.peers.hearing_rad: How far away, in blocks, noise-makers are noticed regardless of the view cone. Sneaking beings are silent; 0 makes a Person deaf.
autarkia.config.option.peers.linger_tick: Object permanence: how long a being stays perceived — frozen as last remembered — after both sight and sound have gone quiet.
autarkia.config.option.peers.heard_activ: How long an activity known only by sound — heard mining, a heard scuffle — stays believed after the noise stops. Afterwards only the bare presence is left.
autarkia.config.option.peers.near_interv: How often, in ticks, a being standing right there is re-checked.
autarkia.config.option.peers.far_interva: How often, in ticks, a being at the edge of range is re-checked. Distances in between fall between the two.
autarkia.config.option.peers.herd_link_r: How far apart two animals of the same species may stand and still count as one herd. Herds link in chains, so a spread-out pasture still joins up.
Base line-of-sight checks per Person per tick. The real budget grows with the backlog, so a large wave of mobs is noticed within a few ticks — checks are deferred, never skipped.
autarkia.config.option.danger.melee_mult: Danger multiplier for a visibly held melee weapon — a zombie with a sword outranks bare claws.
autarkia.config.option.danger.ranged_mul: Danger multiplier for a visibly held ranged weapon: bow, crossbow or trident.
autarkia.config.option.danger.armored_mu: Danger multiplier for visible armor on the body.
autarkia.config.option.danger.mounted_mu: Danger multiplier for a mounted body, such as a skeleton riding a spider or a horse.
Danger multiplier for a baby variant — smaller, faster and harder to hit.
autarkia.config.option.social.hail_radiu: How far away, in blocks, a shouted hail is heard. A hail has to carry further than sight or it would add nothing to simply noticing someone. This also sizes a Person's ear; quieter sounds are still limited to the hearing range.
How long a claimed work site outlives its last heartbeat before another Person may take the spot. 20 ticks is one second.
autarkia.config.option.journal.max_entri: How many journal entries each Person keeps. Older ones are dropped once it fills.
autarkia.config.option.journal.max_age_t: How old a journal entry may get before it is dropped. The default is 10 minutes of game time.
autarkia.config.option.journal.sweep_int: How often the journal clears out entries that have aged past their lifetime.
autarkia.config.option.journal.file_sink: Also mirror each Person's journal to logs/autarkia/<person>.log on disk.
